items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I told him, why don't you go to your father and learn some touch?

ctx.x: Son of a great father, Sonny Payne, and his father was who?
Chris Columbo. I told him, why don't you go to your father and learn some touch? 'Cause I used to see Sonny walking down Seventh Avenue. He had met Chick Webb.
